headline: Mistral opens weights for Large 4
dek: The 1-trillion-parameter model ships under an open license, per Hugging Face.

s2.label: What happened
s2.title: Open weights since Oct 29
body: Mistral published the weights for Mistral Large 4 on October 29, per Hugging Face and Mistral AI.
The model takes text and images and generates text, using a Mixture-of-Experts design, per Hugging Face.

points.t: An MIT derivative that limits hosted services (Hugging Face).

s4.title: Coding and cost

caption.hook: Mistral opened the weights for Large 4, a multimodal model with 1 trillion parameters, per Hugging Face.
body: Per Hugging Face and Mistral AI, the weights went live on October 29 under an MIT-derived license that limits model-as-a-service offerings. Large 4 takes text and images, generates text and has a 1-million-token context window, according to Hugging Face.

Mistral AI claims it leads Terminal-Bench 4.0 among open models, 13 points above its preview, and uses 47% fewer tokens per task than GLM-5.3. It runs on transformers, vLLM and llama.cpp from launch, including GGUF builds for lighter hardware, per Hugging Face.
